decides: This only confirms one point and does not change the pick. findings.label: Runtime ratio, backlight off vs on (derived)
findings.source_title: MX Mechanical Mini For Mac | Logitech (Singapore shop)
findings.note: 10 months × 30.4 days = 304 days; 304 ÷ 15 days = 20.3, so about 20×. The 15-day figure presumably assumes the backlight is on, because it is set against the backlight-off figure; Logitech doesn't state this. The backlight uses a hand-proximity sensor, so real typing likely falls between the two figures.
